summary: End-to-end verification of the new separate hidden Admin Portal (/admin-nubo). Backend pytest (5/5 PASS) and Playwright UI (6/6 scenarios PASS) on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL preview. Backend: (1) POST /api/admin-auth/login with email+password+secret returns 200 with admin token+user (no _id leak). (2) Wrong secret returns 401. (3) Wrong password returns 401. (4) Public POST /api/auth/login with admin email rejected with 401. (5) Brute-force lockout: 6th attempt with throwaway @example.com email returns 429 (first 5 are 401). Frontend: (1) Direct nav to /admin-nubo/panel without auth correctly redirects to /admin-nubo and renders admin-login-page. (2) Wrong secret on /admin-nubo shows toast 'Credenciales o código de acceso inválidos. Te quedan 2 intento(s) antes del bloqueo.' and stays on /admin-nubo. (3) /auth (public login) with admin email shows 'Email o contraseña incorrectos.' and stays on /auth. (4) Successful admin login with all three credentials shows 'Acceso concedido' toast, redirects to /admin-nubo/panel, renders admin-dashboard with admin-map (Leaflet w/ bee markers) and 4 stat cards (Abejas activas 9, Total repartidores 15, Negocios 15, Pedidos 2). (5) Decoupling: NO links/buttons referencing /admin-nubo or 'admin' on landing '/' or '/auth'. (6) robots.txt at preview URL contains 'Disallow: /admin-nubo' and 'Disallow: /admin-nubo/'. AdminLogin component sets <meta name='robots' content='noindex,nofollow,noarchive'>. No console errors aside from expected 401 network logs and benign rrweb warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Brute-force lockout for unknown emails returns 429 with the same Spanish message — good UX/security parity. Verified message correctness on real admin: 'Te quedan N intento(s) antes del bloqueo.'
AdminLogin.js correctly uses meta noindex/nofollow/noarchive and is paired with robots.txt Disallow — defense in depth is in place.

App.js routes correctly gate /admin-nubo/panel behind user.role==='admin' and redirect anonymous users to /admin-nubo login. Customer/driver users would also be redirected (login page shown), confirmed by direct-access test.
Public /auth and Landing carry no link or visible reference to the admin portal — invisibility requirement satisfied.

Minor: AdminLogin POST sends email lowercased+trimmed which is good. Consider trimming password too only if backend tolerates leading/trailing whitespace (current behavior is correct: preserve password).

Minor: the dashboard 'Abejas activas' card shows 9 while admin-map header says '7 abejas en ruta' — possibly two different definitions (active vs. with recent GPS ping). Not a bug, but worth aligning copy if intended to match.

test_credentials.note: Real admin had 1 wrong-secret attempt during UI test then 1 successful login (counter reset on success). Throwaway @example.com email was used for brute-force lockout test, so real admin is NOT locked.

seed_data_creation: None. Brute-force test used uuid-based junk emails at example.com; they never existed in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Separate hidden admin portal is fully functional E2E. Backend admin-auth login enforces email+password+secret_code, rejects bad secret/password (401), and locks per-email after 5 failures (429, 15min window). Public /auth/login rejects role=admin (401). Public pages have zero references to /admin-nubo and robots.txt disallows it. AdminDashboard renders Leaflet map with bee markers and 4 stat cards. Run backend tests with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<preview-url> pytest backend/tests/test_admin_portal.py -v
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration. Initial brute-force test got 422s because the throwaway email used a .test TLD that FastAPI/Pydantic EmailStr rejects as invalid; switched to @example.com and lockout returned 429 as expected.
